title: Nonnegativity of query probability
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite input alphabet with probability law $\pi$, and let $T$ be a randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space. For every coordinate $i$, the probability that $T$ queries $i$ under independent inputs of law $\pi$ is nonnegative.
hypotheses_covered: Randomized decision tree with finite nonempty seed space and seed law
